caption:
The video captures a woman dancing in a studio with white walls, a pale wood floor, ceiling track lights and a wall air-conditioning unit. She stands with her back to the camera, facing a full-height mirror. The reversed figure in the glass is her reflection, not a second person. In a black sleeveless top and a ruffled leopard-print skirt, one hand rests on her hip as her other arm, bent low, swings outward to the right.

The arm lifts, sweeping from horizontal into a steep diagonal and then straight overhead. As it rises, her head and torso turn slightly. Her ponytail and skirt ruffles sway with the movement. The raised hand shifts from an open, spread-finger palm into a pointing gesture with the index finger extended. The mirror tracks every change, its reflected arm climbing and its hand reshaping in step. Her feet stay largely planted, with only small weight shifts, so she does not travel. The clip opens mid-sweep and closes while the raised, pointing arm is still held in motion.
